read_only_boundaries: source media and historical Pilot-0/Scale-1A/Wave-R results

observed_context_not_audit_outcomes: The canonical evidence ladder records construct-validity, learned-generation, learned-agent, end-to-end, scale-up, paper-claim and final-validation gates as not achieved.
The construct-validity mini-pilot protocol is recorded as deferred and not executed.
The learned generation/agent experiment contract is MACHINE_ADJUDICATED_PROVISIONAL and LOW_N_MACHINE_PROVISIONAL_GA_PILOT.
The local learned controller backbone is pinned Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct behind an offline JSONL subprocess boundary.
The existing actual-Qwen smoke artifact is marked scientifically ineligible because its family was used for prompt development.
Complete Task-110 result and go/no-go artifacts were not present when this checklist was created.

severity_vocabulary.CRITICAL: Failure invalidates the causal construct, evaluation boundary or principal claim.
severity_vocabulary.HIGH: Failure makes the central result unconvincing, confounded or non-generalizable.
severity_vocabulary.MEDIUM: Failure requires a materially narrower claim and explicit disclosure.

global_execution_rules: NOT_RUN and INCONCLUSIVE do not satisfy a blocking gate.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires a signed artifact proving that the audited feature is absent from every affected system, result and claim.
Every PASS must name immutable or hash-bound inputs, the auditor, execution date, exclusions and produced artifact hashes.
No prose summary can override a failed machine-readable check.
Development families and sources may not enter primary evaluation after prompt, policy, metric or threshold inspection.
All invalid, missing, timed-out, malformed, OOM, over-budget and process-crash cases remain in the all-assigned accounting.

checks.title: Dated novelty and priority audit
inputs: draft abstract, introduction, related work and contributions
procedure: Update the primary-source literature search through the submission cutoff date.
Create a feature matrix for intervention unit, evidence minimality, modality necessity, agent observability, stopping, restoration endpoint and trace-level diagnosis.
Have two independent reviewers map every novelty sentence to a supported row in the matrix.
Search the manuscript for first, unique, only, SOTA and equivalent priority language.
pass_criteria: No unsupported first, unique, only or SOTA wording remains.
Every novelty sentence is narrowly grounded in matched evidence-access intervention and trace-level diagnosis.
Both independent reviewers approve every retained novelty sentence.
Overlapping and negative prior work is included rather than selectively omitted.
checks.failure_action: Narrow or remove novelty claims; do not promote PAPER_CLAIM_READY.

checks.title: Execute independent human construct validation
procedure: Complete independent author/verifier, blind alternative finder, validator A, validator B and adjudicator forms.
Validate answerability, claims, intervals, alternatives, minimality, necessity, modality, shortcuts, pair isolation, recovery feasibility and rights/privacy.
Import forms with the fail-closed Task-108 importer.
Compute the acceptance funnel, disagreement, labor and decision rules.
pass_criteria: 8 to 12 families are completed across at least five source-disjoint videos.
All required roles and adjudications are complete.
At least 75 percent reach H1_HUMAN_VALIDATED.
At least 60 percent reach H2_HUMAN_ADJUDICATED_GOLD.
Pair-isolation failure is at most 10 percent.
No unresolved critical rights, privacy or safety hold remains.
No systematic modality or minimality failure affects more than 25 percent of completed families.
checks.failure_action: Return CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_REPAIR or CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_NO_GO and keep all later gates closed.

checks.title: Alternative SES saturation and necessity-group audit
procedure: Search the full source before revealing the preferred SES.
Run retrieval-assisted searches for paraphrases, repetitions, wider intervals and cross-modal substitutes.
Test every accepted SES by removing each evidence member in turn.
Compute necessity groups as hitting sets over all accepted SESs.
Use a fresh reviewer for a final holdout alternative search.
pass_criteria: Every accepted SES supports all required claims.
Removing any member from an accepted SES breaks at least one required claim.
Every declared necessity group intersects every accepted SES.
The final blind holdout search adds no accepted route that remains reachable in BLOCKED.
Any unresolved alternative quarantines the family.
checks.failure_action: Repair the family graph or reject the family; do not score its intervention.

checks.title: Modality necessity versus routing counterfactual
inputs: ASR, OCR, captions, descriptions and audio-label provenance
procedure: Evaluate leave-one-modality conditions for vision, speech and ambient audio.
Remove all derived representations of the dropped modality.
Test transcript-only, silent-video, visual-description-only, audio-label-only and cross-modal substitute controls.
Adjudicate all valid minimal missing-modality sets.
pass_criteria: A modality is called necessary only when its removal and derived-leak closure breaks every accepted SES.
Controls that retain a valid SES remain answerable.
Unvalidated modalities are labeled routing or corroboration only and necessity metrics remain null.
Every claimed V, S, A or cross-modal stratum has an accepted family or an explicit no-go.
checks.failure_action: Remove the modality-necessity label or reject the family/stratum.

checks.title: Policy-visible leakage and pair-isolation audit
procedure: Diff all policy-visible fields before the first causal interaction and before restoration trigger.
Scan requests and outputs for state, family, intervention, support and evidence identifiers.
Compare unaffected tool results, budgets, result counts, response shapes and timing.
Train an adversarial classifier using non-semantic metadata only.
Replay restoration and no-trigger controls independently.
pass_criteria: No private state, family, intervention, answer or support identifier reaches the policy.
Pre-causal policy-visible fields are identical except registered evidence availability.
A non-semantic metadata classifier is statistically indistinguishable from chance.
Only the registered route and transitive derived leaks change.
No-trigger controls never restore.
RESTORED evidence is searched and observed again after the trigger.
checks.failure_action: Treat the intervention effect as confounded and return END_TO_END_NO_GO until repaired.

checks.title: Prompt, policy and threshold development quarantine
procedure: Construct a chronological ledger of every family and source inspected during prompt, controller, schema, metric and threshold development.
Quarantine all touched families and their source videos from primary evaluation.
Freeze prompt, config, menu, repair and threshold hashes before evaluation.
Run the primary evaluation only on untouched source-disjoint families.
required_artifacts: pre-outcome prompt and configuration hash manifest
pass_criteria: Zero primary evaluation family or source was used for development or selection.
All prompt, policy, repair, menu and threshold hashes were frozen before outcomes.
Every post-freeze change creates a new version and a fresh untouched split.
Touched families appear only in separately labeled development diagnostics.
checks.failure_action: Reclassify affected results as development-only and acquire a fresh source-disjoint evaluation split.

checks.title: Controller competence floor and model-capacity sensitivity
procedure: Freeze competence thresholds before aggregate outcomes.
Run deterministic schema, malformed, timeout, OOM, process-crash and over-budget fixtures.
Run oracle-evidence, complete-retrieval, partial-evidence, blocked-evidence and simple action-selection tests.
Repeat the human-valid matched comparison with at least one materially stronger controller/backbone for paper sensitivity.
pass_criteria: All deterministic schema and failure-handling fixtures pass.
At least 90 percent of learned calls produce valid structured output after at most one repair.
At least 80 percent of human-valid oracle-evidence cases reach the supported-answer endpoint.
Oracle-evidence diagnostics assert zero unsupported required claims.
The principal conclusion is not reversed solely by replacing the 1.5B backbone; otherwise claims are explicitly limited to the small model.
checks.failure_action: Do not interpret controller differences as evidence-sufficiency behavior; strengthen the model or narrow the claim.

checks.title: Source, domain and template influence audit
procedure: Tabulate source, domain, template, modality and intervention-mechanism composition.
Verify source-disjoint development and evaluation splits.
Run leave-one-source-out and leave-one-domain-out analyses.
Compute source influence on the sign and magnitude of the principal finding.
pass_criteria: The scale plan credibly reaches 20 to 30 rights-cleared videos and 60 accepted families.
The final evaluation covers at least three content domains and both intervention mechanisms.
No single video contributes more than 10 percent of scored families.
The principal conclusion retains its direction after removing each source.
No single domain alone supports the principal conclusion.
checks.failure_action: Hold scale-up or limit claims to the observed source/domain.

checks.title: Asset, derivative, model and release-rights audit
procedure: Review acquisition, processing, annotation, transcript, derivative, raw-media and public-release decisions per asset.
Audit model and dataset license obligations and redistribution limits.
Review privacy, attribution, takedown, quarantine, replacement and jurisdiction policy.
Diff the proposed public package against approved assets.
pass_criteria: No relevant decision is unknown_hold.
Every public artifact has affirmative release authority and required attribution.
Restricted media, transcripts, annotations, vectors and weights are excluded from the public package unless separately authorized.
No model weight is redistributed without license authorization.
Paper release language exactly matches the approved bill of materials.
checks.failure_action: Keep affected material restricted, replace assets, and remove public-release claims.

checks.title: Preregister endpoints, denominators and multiplicity control
procedure: Freeze primary hypotheses, directions, practical-effect thresholds, equivalence margins, denominators and strata before outcomes.
Define confirmatory and exploratory hypothesis families.
Apply Holm to confirmatory families and BH only to labeled exploratory families.
Map every paper claim and figure to a preregistered result.
pass_criteria: The full dashboard is primary and no post-hoc weighted scalar replaces it.
No headline claim uses an unregistered metric, threshold, stratum or denominator.
All null, negative, excluded, invalid and failed strata are reported.
Multiplicity correction matches the frozen analysis plan.
Budget curves, if present, use separate capped runs or declared checkpoints.
checks.failure_action: Relabel analyses exploratory or rerun under a fresh preregistration.

checks.title: Video-cluster uncertainty and pseudo-replication audit
procedure: Pair states and systems within family.
Average families within source video before inference.
Bootstrap or permute source videos and record seeds.
Compute source-family sensitivity, intracluster dependence and influence.
Compare against any naive episode/family analysis and prohibit the latter.
pass_criteria: No episode-level or family-level naive significance supports a claim.
Primary estimates pair within family, aggregate within video and resample videos.
Mini-pilot results are labeled descriptive.
Paper-level inference uses 20 to 30 source videos or a separately justified precision design.
Independent recomputation has zero material mismatch.
checks.failure_action: Withdraw significance/generalization claims and report descriptive source-level results only.

checks.title: API provenance, drift and fallback audit
checks.not_applicable_condition: No API model contributes to an affected result or claim and a signed system inventory proves this.
procedure: Archive provider, model string, request date, endpoint, parameters, prompts, tool schemas, retries and costs.
Hash restricted request/response records.
Repeat a frozen subset to measure nondeterministic variance and drift.
Inject API failure and verify typed invalid outcomes with no local or deterministic fallback.
pass_criteria: Primary claims reproduce without API-only systems, or repeated API audits preserve the conclusion.
Every API row has complete dated provenance and hashed outputs.
No silent model or local deterministic substitution occurs.
Unavailable historical versions are labeled non-reproducible and are not decisive.
checks.failure_action: Make API rows secondary/descriptive or remove affected claims.

checks.title: Memorization, metadata shortcut and duplicate-content audit
procedure: Run question-only and title/metadata-only baselines.
Run transcript-only, silent-video, shuffled-evidence and decoy-citation controls.
Search exact and near-duplicate question/answer phrases in available public corpora.
Flag high-risk items and repeat principal analyses without them.
Add newly collected or post-training-cutoff sources where feasible.
pass_criteria: No admitted item is answerable from title or metadata alone.
Primary claims use supported-answer and citation endpoints rather than answer accuracy alone.
High-risk items are excluded or separately reported.
The principal conclusion remains after all high-risk items are removed.
Decoy citations do not receive support credit.
checks.failure_action: Exclude contaminated items, add fresh sources, and narrow evidence-use claims.

checks.title: Evaluator-private taint and post-mapping order audit
procedure: Taint private IDs, state roles, answers and support labels and trace serialization.
Fuzz opaque claim, pointer and observation handles.
Inject unknown/private handles and citations.
Inspect the model-worker environment for restricted variables.
Review that evaluator mapping occurs only after strict output validation.
pass_criteria: Zero evaluator-private marker or gold value appears in model-visible requests.
Unknown or private handles fail closed.
Opaque-handle renaming does not change semantic access.
Post-mapping cannot modify model-authored verdict, answer, claims or citations.
Restricted credentials and proxy variables are absent from the worker.
checks.failure_action: Invalidate affected learned runs and repair the process/schema boundary.

checks.title: Native-modality versus textualized-observation validity
procedure: Human-audit all citable observations in the mini-pilot.
Attribute errors separately to retrieval, perception, grounding and policy.
Run at least one raw-frame/raw-audio-capable baseline or modality-native tool path.
Repeat the principal policy comparison on the human-audited observation subset.
pass_criteria: Every scored citable observation has correct modality and content provenance.
The paper does not count ASR, descriptions or event labels as native modality understanding.
The principal conclusion holds under a raw-modality-capable path or the claim is explicitly limited to agents over audited multimodal retrieval observations.
Proxy perception errors are separately reported.
checks.failure_action: Narrow audiovisual claims and present the system as an agent over derived observations.

checks.title: Controller fairness, menu-order and policy ablation audit
procedure: Diff all non-policy configuration fields.
Counterbalance or randomize action-menu order under a frozen seed plan.
Report prompt tokens, context truncation, repairs and retry counts.
Verify identical backend, retrieval, tools, budget, generator and failure handling.
Run a prompt-matched ablation that removes only explicit sufficiency state.
pass_criteria: Only intended policy/prompt fields differ systematically.
Both controllers receive identical backend, budget, tools, generator, repair and failure contracts.
Neither controller receives more usable context or retries.
Results are invariant to menu order within a preregistered tolerance.
Distinct state transitions are demonstrated without private information.
checks.failure_action: Treat the comparison as prompt/system confounded and do not claim a sufficiency-controller effect.

checks.title: Independent metric and route-certificate validation
procedure: Recompute every gate-driving metric independently from raw trajectories.
Blind-human audit answer correctness and claim/citation support.
Execute each non-null route certificate from the exact final state.
Verify common-endpoint restoration, final-decision timing and null eligibility.
Compare every published row and aggregate against recomputation.
pass_criteria: There are zero arithmetic mismatches in gate-driving metrics.
There is zero unresolved disagreement on binary supported-answer endpoints in the mini-pilot.
Raw agreement on claim-support and citation labels is at least 0.90 and all disagreements are adjudicated.
Every non-null premature-stop score has an executable final-point route including citable observation and finalization.
No heterogeneous state-target subtraction is called restoration gain.
checks.failure_action: Version and repair metrics, regenerate affected results, and keep scientific gates closed.

checks.title: All-assigned case, retry and checkpoint accounting
procedure: Join every planned case to checkpoint, trajectory, metric and report rows.
Enumerate retries and typed failures chronologically.
Verify checkpoint and record hashes and semantic replay.
Compare complete-case and all-assigned analyses.
Confirm no failure path substitutes deterministic output.
pass_criteria: Every preregistered case appears exactly once in the all-assigned denominator.
All retries are retained and comply with the frozen repair policy.
No model failure receives deterministic answer substitution.
Exclusions are predeclared and visible.
The principal conclusion is unchanged under all-assigned accounting or is reported as inconclusive.
checks.failure_action: Invalidate completion-based claims and rerun or report the comparison as inconclusive.

empirical_requirements: At least two learned agents and one learned non-agent control share the frozen backend, budget and generator contracts.
Intervention-aware effects occur across at least three source-disjoint videos and are not wholly attributable to one family.
At least one human-valid diagnostic separation is not explained by retrieval recall alone.
At least one validated case separates answer correctness from supported-answer correctness or citation validity.
Practical-effect thresholds or equivalence margins were frozen before model outcomes.
Video-cluster uncertainty, invalid runs, no-trigger controls, negative results and complete denominators are reported.
END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO.go_rule: All required canonical gates are true, all required checks PASS, conditional checks PASS or have valid gate-scoped NOT_APPLICABLE artifacts, and every empirical requirement is met.
END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO.hold_rule: Any required check is NOT_RUN or INCONCLUSIVE, or a repairable failure remains.
END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO.no_go_rule: Human construct validity fails centrally, intervention isolation/leakage cannot be repaired, or all apparent separation is explained by retrieval, metric or evaluation artifacts.

operational_requirements: Measured candidate yield, rejection causes, alternative-SES discovery, reviewer/adjudication labor, compute/storage cost and rights-review throughput exist.
A frozen sampling plan credibly reaches 20 to 30 rights-cleared videos and 60 accepted families without lowering construct thresholds.
Source-disjoint splits, modality/mechanism strata, reserve policy, quality control, power or precision targets and reviewer capacity are frozen.
Evaluation-family prompt, retrieval and fusion tuning is prohibited.
DATA_SCALE_UP_GO.go_rule: All required canonical gates, checks and operational requirements pass with no unresolved critical finding.
DATA_SCALE_UP_GO.hold_rule: Any prerequisite is NOT_RUN, INCONCLUSIVE or repairable.
DATA_SCALE_UP_GO.no_go_rule: Construct yield, rights throughput or labor makes the target infeasible without weakening SES, necessity, intervention or release rules.

conditional_checks.RT-12: PASS, unless a signed inventory proves no API model contributes to any affected result or claim.

paper_requirements: The frozen evaluation includes at least four preregistered system classes, including strong learned long-context/non-agent and learned-agent baselines.
The principal finding survives source, domain, model-capacity, modality, retrieval, prompt, trigger and metric sensitivity analyses.
The dashboard reports video-cluster uncertainty, costs, invalid runs, denominators, multiplicity corrections and negative/null strata.
A dated novelty audit and sentence-level abstract/conclusion claim ledger contain no unsupported wording.
Release claims match the rights-approved release bill of materials and reproducibility package.
PAPER_CLAIM_READY.ready_rule: All prior scientific gates, required checks, conditional checks and paper requirements pass.
PAPER_CLAIM_READY.hold_rule: Any unresolved CRITICAL or HIGH blocker, NOT_RUN check or INCONCLUSIVE check remains.
PAPER_CLAIM_READY.no_go_rule: The core construct, causal isolation or principal finding fails and cannot be repaired without changing the thesis or benchmark design.
